headline: Approved $900,000 in opioid settlement money for a winter warming shelter at 166 Riverside Industrial Parkway; an emergency declaration at 654 Riverside Street failed.
summary: A parking fee increase for the First Light Commons lots was approved, along with a 20-year Northeast Air ground lease extension tied to a hangar replacement of at least $4 Million. A $350,000 opioid-fund shelter order was postponed indefinitely, and a motion to postpone the Experience Maine catering application at 54 Danforth Street failed 4-5.
decisions: Approved amending the Portland Development Corporation's business assistance guidelines for job creation, 9-0.
Approved Order 72-26/27 granting a catering and outdoor dining permit for Experience Maine at 54 Danforth Street, 9-0.
Failed 4-5 to postpone Order 72-26/27 on the Experience Maine permit at 54 Danforth Street.
Approved Order 73-26/27 granting an outdoor dining permit for The Sports Bra at 476 Stevens Avenue, 9-0.
Approved Order 66-26/27 changing the traffic schedule for Lancaster Street, 9-0.
Approved Order 67-26/27 raising the administrative parking fee at the First Light Commons parking lots, 9-0.
Postponed Order 68-26/27 on $350,000 in opioid settlement funds for a winter warming shelter indefinitely, 9-0.
Approved Order 70-26/27 providing $900,000 in opioid settlement funds for a winter warming shelter at 166 Riverside Industrial Parkway as an emergency, as amended, 7-2.
Failed 4-5 to pass Order 74-26/27 declaring a state of limited emergency at 654 Riverside Street as an emergency.
Approved Order 75-26/27 extending the Northeast Air ground lease by 20 years, conditional on a hangar replacement of at least $4 Million, 9-0.
Approved Order 76-26/27 approving the purchase and sale agreement between Nordic Maine LLC and Portland for Portland Technology Park Units 3 and 5, 9-0.
Approved Order 77-26/27 authorizing a salary increase for Corporation Counsel, 9-0.
